subject: Can we change properties of dataTableOutput?

messages.author: c104d3284c968407
messages.subject: Can we change properties of dataTableOutput?
parts:
HI I am working on an Application in R Shiny, in which we display log data using dataTableOutput. I want to change the properties of the table (e.g. Font, Color, column width, cell background), but I could not find any option to do that. Is there any way to do it in R Shiny?

Regards,
Manali

messages.author: dea7fe9fc1920d2f
messages.subject: Re: Can we change properties of dataTableOutput?
parts:
D3TableFilter is a new table widget for Shiny. It is based on D3.js. Among other features it supports colouring and styling of tables using D3 functions. Example code for many different color scales is in the "colour" example app, examples of text styling can be found in the "interaction" example.

See: https://github.com/ThomasSiegmund/D3TableFilter

Best

Thomas
